purpose: Fold-safe memorization baselines for the 19-feature detector, computed to be reported beside the 5-fold CV (v4 addition, panel-mandated). Confirms the paper's existing 22-vector census and shows the RF adds no measurable value over a 22-entry lookup table, while generalization to an unseen feature vector is nil. Generated by paper_a/verify_lookup_baseline.py from the IED factorial (P1_JSONL). git_dirty; not a preregistered analysis; exploratory diagnostic only.

out_of_fold_lookup_majority_vote.note: train-fold labels only; unseen test vectors fall back to the training-fold prior. AUC matches the full 19-feature RF (0.9904), so the RF adds no measurable value over the 22-vector codebook.

leave_one_vector_out.note: GroupKFold grouped on the 22 distinct vectors: every test vector is absent from training, so only the global prior is available. Accuracy collapses to the majority-class prior and AUC is non-informative: the detector does not generalize to an unseen feature vector.
